gloss: respect for the aged; honoring the elderly

definitions.gloss: respect for the aged; honoring the elderly
definitions.explanation: The concept and practice of showing respect and care for elderly people. Also appears in the name of the national holiday 敬老の日.

examples.japanese: {敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦おじいちゃん→おじいちゃん：20642_ojiichan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my grandfather flowers on Respect for the Aged Day.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ} (Respect for the Aged Day) is a Japanese national holiday celebrated on the third Monday of September. It was established in 1966 to honor elderly citizens. Communities typically hold {敬老|けいろう}{会|かい} (senior citizens' gatherings) and families visit or give gifts to grandparents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ} (Respect for the Aged Day)
- {敬老|けいろう}{会|かい} (senior citizens' gathering)
- {敬老|けいろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (spirit of respect for elders)
- {敬老|けいろう}⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧ (celebration for the elderly)
